metadata.title: Eric Saubert catches touchdown in Week 3
metadata.description: Eric Saubert caught one of his two targets for 13 yards and one touchdown in the Seahawks' 33-31 loss to the Washington Commanders in Week 3.
metadata.analysis: Saubert remains minimally involved in the Seattle passing attack early on, recording less than two receptions in each of the first three contests. The tight end remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers.

metadata.title: Eric Saubert practices Saturday
metadata.description: Eric Saubert was able to practice at Seahawks training camp on Saturday.
metadata.analysis: Saubert missed time earlier in the Seahawks offseason program. He'll hold a depth role in the Seahawks tight end room.

metadata.title: Eric Saubert (hamstring) off injury report for Super Bowl
metadata.description: Eric Saubert is off the injury report for the Super Bowl against the Patriots.
metadata.analysis: Saubert closed the week with a full practice on Friday. He is officially a full-go heading into the big game on Sunday.

metadata.title: Eric Saubert (hamstring) logs full practice Thursday
metadata.description: Eric Saubert was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Saubert was one of many full participants for Seattle with one day of practice left before the Super Bowl. He should be good to go on Sunday.

metadata.title: Eric Saubert (hamstring) logs full practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Eric Saubert was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Saubert was off the injury report last week. He remains on track to be good to go in the Super Bowl on Sunday.

metadata.title: Eric Saubert (hamstring) off injury report for Super Bowl
metadata.description: Eric Saubert is off the injury report for the Super Bowl next Sunday against the Patriots.
metadata.analysis: Saubert missed a pair of practices to end the week. He'll still be good to go in his usual blocking role for the Seahawks.

metadata.title: Eric Saubert (hamstring) misses practice Thursday
metadata.description: Eric Saubert did not practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Saubert gets downgraded after he was limited in practice on Wednesday. He still has over a week to get healthy for the Super Bowl next Sunday.

metadata.title: Eric Saubert (hamstring) estimated as limited in practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Eric Saubert was listed as limited on Wednesday's estimated injury report.
metadata.analysis: Saubert should remain in his primary blocking role heading into the Super Bowl.

metadata.title: Eric Saubert - No targets in win
metadata.description: Saubert wasn't targeted in Sunday's 31-27 win over the Rams in the NFC Championship Game.
metadata.analysis: Saubert served as the No. 2 tight end behind AJ Barner, handling 38 of 67 offensive snaps (57 percent). His workload could get reduced if Elijah Arroyo is active for the Super Bowl versus the Patriots, but regardless, he's not a dependable fantasy option with just 41 receiving yards through the regular season and postseason.

metadata.title: Eric Saubert - Handles increased workload
metadata.description: Saubert caught two of three targets for 10 yards in Saturday's 13-3 win over the 49ers.
metadata.analysis: Saubert logged a season-high 72 percent snap share, pacing ahead of AJ Barner, who handled a 60 percent share. This likely won't continue in the playoffs, as Saubert has recorded just four receptions for 31 yards through 11 games this season.

metadata.title: Eric Saubert - Blanked in win
metadata.description: Saubert didn't catch either of his two targets in Sunday's 27-10 win over the Panthers.
metadata.analysis: Saubert handled 52 percent of the offensive snaps, a season high for the veteran tight end, but he mostly stuck to a blocking role. The 2017 fifth-round pick has been targeted just four times over 10 games.
